metadata.source: openai/gsm8k (main config, train+test) + procedural synthetic template generator
metadata.description: Multi-step arithmetic word problems with computation traces, plus deterministic error-injection variants labeled by mod-9 checksum detectability.

examples.input: Mike decides to buy a new camera.  He wants to buy a top-of-the-line camera but he decides to wait for the new model to come out.  The new model costs 30% more than the current model.  The old camera cost $4000.  He gets $200 off a $400 lens he bought.  How much did he pay for the camera and lens?
An amusement park sells tickets for $3. This week it welcomed 100 people per day but on Saturday it was visited by 200 people and on Sunday by 300. How much money did it make overall in a week?

It costs $.10 to print one page. Jenny wants to print 7 copies of her 25-page essay. She also wants to buy 7 pens that each cost $1.50. If she pays the store with 2 twenty dollar bills, how much money should she get in change?
Jessie's community built a new hedge. Each section of the hedge used 30 pieces of concrete blocks that cost $2 per piece. The hedge has eight sections. How much did they spend on the concrete blocks?

James invests $2000 a week into his bank account.  He had $250,000 in his account when the year started.  At the end of the year, he gets a windfall that is worth 50% more than what he has in his bank account.   How much money does he have?
Joe’s mother gave him $56 to go to the store. Joe bought 7 notebooks and 2 books. Each notebook costs $4 and each book costs $7. How much money does Joe have left?

There are 3 workers producing chairs in a furniture factory. Each of them produces 4 chairs an hour. As a group, they produce an additional chair every 6 hours. In total, how many chairs have been produced after 6 hours?

A farmer gets 20 pounds of bacon on average from a pig. He sells each pound for $6 at the monthly farmer’s market. This month’s pig is a runt that grew to only half the size of the average pig. How many dollars will the farmer make from the pig’s bacon?
To make a lasagna Martha needs 1.5kg of cheese and 500 grams of meat. The cheese costs $6 per kilogram, and the meat $8 per kilogram. How much does Martha need to pay for the ingredients?

The cheese pizza is cut into 12 slices and the pepperoni pizza is cut into 8 slices.  If Kate’s 6 friends each eat 6 cheese pizza slices and 4 pepperoni pizza slices, how many pizza pies does she need to buy?

A recipe uses 426 grams of an ingredient per batch, and a baker scales it up to 6 batches. 26 grams are lost to spillage during mixing. The batter is then split evenly into 2 equal portions and only one portion is kept. 73 grams are lost to spillage during mixing. How many grams remain in the kept portion?

A traveler moves at 65 units per hour for 6 hours on the first leg of a trip. On the next leg they travel 2 more hours at 136 units per hour. They then backtrack 49 units to retrieve a dropped item. On the next leg they travel 4 more hours at 90 units per hour. They then backtrack 100 units to retrieve a dropped item. On the next leg they travel 6 more hours at 120 units per hour. What is the total distance covered?

An item costs $757 and a shopper buys 8 of them. Then the shopper adds $174 in shipping/extra fees. Then a discount of one-5th of the running total is applied. Then the shopper adds $211 in shipping/extra fees. Then a discount of one-2th of the running total is applied. Then the shopper adds $8 in shipping/extra fees. What is the final total?

The batter is then split evenly into 2 equal portions and only one portion is kept. 153 grams are lost to spillage during mixing. How many grams remain in the kept portion?

A worker logs 8 units of work and a supervisor multiplies it by a conversion factor of 4. A bonus of 19 converted units is added. What is the final converted amount for that team?

A warehouse starts with 59 units in stock and receives a restock of 24 units. Then 17 units are sold. The remaining stock is repacked into 2 equal-sized crates and one crate is shipped out for audit.
